videos.title: Park People
videos.overview: Young Frank Brady falls in love with a woman he has only seen from a distance. He enlists his friend Peg to help him win the woman's love.

videos.title: Bangelstein's Boys
videos.overview: A rugby team's annual tour descends into chaos when Tommy and Jack have a fall out with their brother-in-law.

videos.title: MacNeil
videos.overview: Carpenter and widower MacNeil takes a blunt approach in making advances to lady executive Miss Saville who works in the same firm as himself. His belief in his instincts regarding women is contradicted by his daughter Mary, who knows him better than he thinks.

videos.title: Emlyn
videos.overview: Mary MacNeil drifts into a complex relationship with a Welsh barrister.

videos.title: Tiger Trap in the Street
videos.overview: Fed up with having his car stolen, Williams decides it's time to take the law into his own hands, but there is a price to pay.

videos.title: An Hour of Love #1: The Bind
An Hour of Love #2: Anatomy of a Divorce
Pig in a Poke
videos.overview: An effete television producer and his beautiful wife move into an old terraced house.In the basement is a sitting tenant they cannot move.The tenant starts to invade their life with increasing voracity, leading to him eventually beating up the young wife and then becoming her afternoon lover.

videos.title: Machine
videos.overview: Two people (one rich, one poor) have failing kidneys, an expensive kidney machine would save them.

videos.title: The Dirt on Lucy Lane
videos.overview: Michael Vint, an embittered hack reporter from a Sunday newspaper, is sent down into the country to find a story in the love life of an aging has-been writer and his new glamorous young film star wife. The writer is annoyed about the intrusion into his private life, but his wife sees it as an opportunity.

videos.title: Moonlight on the Highway
videos.overview: Writing for ITV Saturday Night Theatre (1969), Dennis Potter introduced the notion that popular music expresses the yearning of the human spirit for a better world. A troubled young man, David Peters (Ian Holm), claims, "Once dreams were possible, that's what the popular songs told us." Rejecting rock music of the day, Peters is immersed in the tunes of Thirties crooner Al Bowlly (killed during the London blitz). He collects Bowlly memorabilia, publishes the Bowlly fan-club newsletter, and finds pleasure in lip-synching Bowlly records but his obsession with Bowlly masks certain darker events in his past.

videos.title: Hazel and Her New Gas Cooker
Steve
videos.overview: Steve's maverick personality costs him his teaching job. He drops out of conventional society and earns a living by roguish means. Then he meets Paula, who makes him question his ideals and life.

videos.title: Rogues Gallery: The Bright Eyed Body Snatcher
Rogues Gallery: A Bed Full of Miracles
The Haunting
videos.overview: Young Cathy asks her teacher Kate for help with her father Rolf who is still withdrawn and depressed after his wife's fatal car crash sometime ago. However, the line between fantasy and reality complicates matters.

videos.title: Every Day of the Life Man
videos.overview: An innocent man is wrongly picked from an identity parade after a factory robbery because he is black.

videos.title: Salve Regina
videos.overview: In the basement of a department store after the last bomb of World War Three. A bag lady, calls herself ' the queen ' and exercises complete authority over two befuddled men. That is until an astronaut (who was in space when the bomb fell) finds them.

videos.title: Takeover
videos.overview: Suddenly and inexplicably Mother and Father find that their previously well behaved adolescent sons are completely unmanageable, reversing the standard family dynamics.

videos.title: Fly Away Home
videos.overview: A couple return from their holiday to find their house burnt down. Having no insurance, the husband has no option but to rebuild it himself with the help of local handyman Arthur. Local council bureaucracy hinders all the way.

videos.title: That Woman Is Wrecking Our Marriage
Murder: The Colonel and the Naturalist
Hester Lilly
videos.overview: Muriel Ingram (Faith Brook) takes her friend Beatrice played by (Joan Hickson) into her confidence when she becomes suspicious of her husbands preoccupation with a young innocent looking orphan called Hester Lilly, Hester has arrived from Paris to stay with Robert Ingram the head of a boys boarding school.

videos.title: The Full Cheddar
videos.overview: A teacher's concentration frequently wanders as he fantasizes about living a different life.

videos.title: The Comic
videos.overview: Tod a successful comic, is now being threatened by his own insecurities which are straining the relationships with his wife/writers and his fellow troupe of stooges. It might be about Tony Hancock? but it could be about any comedian.

videos.title: Faith and Henry
videos.overview: After the last science lesson of the day at Rivington High School, in St Helens, Lancashire, a young black girl, Faith is joined by a white fellow school pupil, Henry. They strike up a conversation about what they are doing for the evening. Henry persuades Faith to forgo the bus and walk it home instead. They nip to the local shop where Henry picks up his usual weekly order of Lancashire cheese for his family, mum, dad and 3 brothers. What follows is a gentle 1960's ever so innocent multi-racial friendship that was unusual in 1960's St. Helens. They walk around the Sankey canal, get teased by other children with one shouting 'Henry's got a girlfriend' to which Henry comically chases after them before giving up. They climb a local hill where you can see the Welsh hills, Widnes and Bold power station. Henry recites a poem and every feels every so quaint, especially for the industrial north. They return home... new friendships formed.

videos.title: It Calls for a Great Deal of Love
videos.overview: Story of a lonely old woman who falls for a fat crossword puzzle composer.

videos.title: Suffer Little Children
videos.overview: The popularity of the Prime Minister (Lee Montague) has reached an all time low. Facing a serious economic crisis and with threats to his position, the former Post Office worker undergoes a breakdown and reverts to childhood.

videos.title: A Doll's House
videos.overview: Nora Helmer has years earlier committed a forgery in order to save the life of her authoritarian husband Torvald. Now she is being blackmailed lives in fear of her husband's finding out and of the shame such a revelation would bring to his career. But when the truth comes out, Nora is shocked to learn where she really stands in her husband's esteem.

videos.title: Fade Out
videos.overview: A TV news executive gets a sensational story concerning a corrupt politician, only to find that his network bosses want to suppress it.

videos.title: Dangerous Corner
videos.overview: An unexpected suicide prompts much speculation about honesty and theft.

videos.title: The Family Is a Vicious Circle
Lay Down Your Arms
videos.overview: At the time of the 1956 Suez Crisis and the Russian invasion of Hungary, Private Bob Hawk reports to the London Intelligence Office where the strength of Soviet troops is under scrutiny.

videos.title: The Salesman
videos.overview: A door-to-door salesman is selling nothing tangible, but something far more worrying.

videos.title: Married Alive
videos.overview: "Married Alive was a television play written by John Mortimer, that was broadcast on NBC in 1970. "The Colonel" (Robert Culp) is a man claiming to be Liz Jardine's (Diana Rigg) long lost husband who returns after many years and moves into her life.

videos.title: Slattery's Mounted Foot
videos.overview: The intrigues, gossip and prejudices of a close-knit Irish clan living in the north of England.

videos.title: Twelfth Night
videos.overview: After a shipwreck, believing her brother has been killed, Viola disguises herself as a boy named Cesario and becomes a courtier to Orsino, who sends her to deliver a message of his love to Olivia, but she falls for the messenger instead.

videos.title: Dear Janet Rosenberg... Dear Mr. Kooning
Roll on Four O'Clock
videos.overview: In a city comprehensive school that has low expectations and ambitions, pupil Peter Latimer does not conform to the macho culture, and is labeled a homosexual. This leads to bullying, both by the pupils and by some of the teachers.

videos.title: The Policeman and the Cook
videos.overview: Murder mystery in a boarding house based on a Wilkie Collins story.

videos.title: The Dead
videos.overview: Its Christmas 1901, and a group of Dubliners make their annual call on Granny Morkan's island. As the music and wine flows Gabriel's initial contentment with his wife Gretta changes as he realizes his wife's mind is far away thinking about one of the departed just remembered by all - but which one?

videos.title: Tales of Piccadilly: Behind the Spearmint Sign
videos.overview: Private investigator Harry is find his life & work involving debt collection and the like boring and humdrum.Then Helen enters his life with an exciting case involving her missing husband.

videos.title: Tales of Piccadilly: A Room Full of Holes
videos.overview: Pete and Glynis meet in a post office queue for booking long distance phone calls overseas. Their loved ones abroad become less important as they both discover they have a mutual appreciation of Rembrandt.

videos.title: Tales of Piccadilly: The Way Out
The Price
videos.overview: A family convenes after the death of the father. Two brothers and their mother come to terms with the sacrifices and misunderstandings they have carried since the children left home.

videos.title: Arms and the Man
videos.overview: 1865: Swiss captain Bluntschli fights as mercenary in the war between Bulgaria and Serbia. When his group's attacked by a few Bulgarian troopers, he learns that he's got the wrong ammunition for his cannon and has to flee. His flight leads him right into the bedroom of his enemy's fiancée.

videos.title: The Silver Collection
videos.overview: Rachel works in a museum, showing people round the silver collection. Jim, a carpenter, suggests she may be too far removed from real life.

videos.title: Man and Boy
videos.overview: An unscrupulous financial manipulator is down on his luck, and does not hesitate to involve his long-estranged son in his shady dealings.

videos.title: Paper Roses
videos.overview: Facing retirement, elderly journalist Clarence Hubbard reflects on the pointlessness of a life wasted writing banal tabloid human interest, animal, and crime stories. Rather than go quietly to tend roses in a garden, Hubbard begins a series of violent actions not unlike those described in tabloids, and this is heightened by inter cutting tabloid headlines between scenes. Throughout, there are occasional shots of a television critic who watches this very play as it unfolds, and he writes a negative review filled with cleverly phrased but bitter invective.

videos.title: After a Lifetime
videos.overview: The death of 64-year-old engineer Billy Scully leads his two adult sons to reflect on another side of their father, his lifelong political commitment as an activist and trade unionist.

videos.title: Hamlet
videos.overview: Hamlet suspects his uncle has murdered his father to claim the throne of Denmark and the hand of Hamlet's mother, but the prince cannot decide whether or not he should take vengeance.

videos.title: Giants and Ogres
videos.overview: On learning of the death of his ex-wife, American businessman Sam Dirk arranges to meet Daniel - the son he has never known. Sam's attempts at reconciliation seem doomed as Daniel doesn't seem to want to know his father.

videos.title: Fly on the Wall: The General
Fly on the Wall: The Reformer
Fly on the Wall: The Designer
The Birthday Run
videos.overview: The Clarke's ideal holiday is cycling together in the country, but now find their happy world is starting to disappear under heavy traffic and roadworks.

videos.title: Some Distant Shadow
videos.overview: A wife recalls her former lovers and realizes they have all played an important part in her life.

videos.title: Who Killed Santa Claus
videos.overview: Christmas dinner with television personality Barbara Love seems an ideal invitation- until death spoils the proceedings.

videos.title: The Midsummer Dream of Chief Inspector Blossom
videos.overview: Inspector Blossom is one TV's most popular detectives but his actor is fed up playing Blossom and wants to do something different.

videos.title: Another Sunday and Sweet F.A.
videos.overview: Mr. Armistead is the referee for an amateur league Sunday Football match. Disliked and abused by all the players he tries to play fair and ensure they follow the rules. By the end of the match he's had enough and really uses his head to show them that he's not as useless as they all think.

videos.title: A Man About a Dog
videos.overview: Dr. Riordan plans to kill his wife's lover and dissolve the corpse in an acid bath.

videos.title: Whose Life Is It Anyway?
videos.overview: A devoted hospital team battle with man who does not want to live anymore.

videos.title: The Last Journey
videos.overview: The story of the last days in the life of the great writer Leo Tolstoy, whose passionate concern for the people of Russia began to destroy his relationship with his wife Sonya.

videos.title: Ben Spray
videos.overview: Ben Spray is a fantasist who tries to impress people with outrageous tales of his life. His girlfriend's flatmate, Louise asks him come to a Bonfire Party, exposing himself as the fool but she is lonely and desperate which scares him.

videos.title: Madly in Love
videos.overview: Angus, a shy young poet, attempts to woo a girl called Mary.

videos.title: Last Year's Confetti
videos.overview: Recently married Jenny asks her mother Rosa advice about the unhappiness she feels, but her mother cannot offer any solace as she reveals she has also been unhappily married.

videos.title: Before Paris
videos.overview: Ruth and John bump into each other on a holiday after 25 years apart. Ruth remembers their romance together as being one of the biggest influences on her life while John seems to have trouble remembering anything about it.

videos.title: When the Wheel Turns
videos.overview: A man decides to leave his job, sell his home and set out for adventure. But his wife has other ideas.

videos.title: The Death of Adolf Hitler
videos.overview: The final days in the Bunker, with Hitler becoming more and more paranoid, plumbing the depths of his madness and reaching his well deserved fate.

videos.title: The Ruffian on the Stair
videos.overview: Mike and Joyce are a poor London couple living in a bedsit. One day while Joyce is alone, a young man named Wilson arrives and asks for a room.

videos.title: A.D.A.M.
videos.overview: Roger Empson builds a house for his disabled wife Jean that is completely automated and monitored by a computer called A.D.A.M. (Automated Domestic Appliance Monitor). When she was a child, Jean had imagined that her dolls used to love her. Now, events take a nasty turn when Jean starts imagining that A.D.A.M. is falling in love with her.

videos.title: Long Day's Journey Into Night
videos.overview: On a day in the summer of 1912, the family of retired matinee idol James Tyrone grapples with the morphine addiction of Tyrone's wife Mary, the illness of their youngest son Edmund, and the alcoholism and debauchery of the older son Jamie. As day turns into night, guilt, anger, despair, and regret threaten to destroy the family.

videos.title: Reckoning Day
videos.overview: The Coopers and the Nicholsons have been friends for years, but their relationship reaches an unexpected crisis point.

videos.title: It Only Hurts for a Minute
videos.overview: Respected (but out of work and broke) film cameraman Harry Griffin is offered a job to film a blue movie.

videos.title: Hopcraft Into Europe
videos.overview: A bored and frustrated Englishman leaves his fiancee and takes his model airplane business to France. There, he is immediately contacted by a beautiful, mysterious Frenchwoman who teaches English, and whose son is a Maoist revolutionary.

videos.title: In the Heel of the Hunt
No Harm Done
videos.overview: A factory manager releases the keys of his premises to thugs who threaten him with a gun. He is left physically unharmed but what about his mind?

videos.title: Only the Other Day
videos.overview: Old friends realize that life and age has worn away the reactionary socialist principals they shared in their youth.

videos.title: Conflict
videos.overview: Set in Ireland where the Catholic Church has been superseded by a repressive order with new ideas. When a group of Irish monks rebel, a Vatican official is sent to bring order once more.
